subject: Recap + stakeholder map / evidence requests — Skyward Health
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@skywardhealth.com>, Ben Chu <ben.chu@skywardhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, Jun 1, 2026 at 3:10 PM -0700
Subject: Recap + stakeholder map / evidence requests — Skyward Health

Hi Alice / Ben —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

1) Key pain / decision criteria (as we understand it)
- Reduce P95 inference latency for chart summarization (current infra spikes at 1.2s)
- Predictable per-token cost and ability to cap spend per environment
- Data residency / auditability for PHI ingestion and retention controls

2) Stakeholders called out on the call
- Economic buyer: Marta Ruiz, CFO (decision authority on pricing/contract)
- Procurement: procurement@skywardhealth.com (manages legal redlines)
- Security reviewer: Tom Everett, Senior Security Engineer (technical evidence owner)
- Day-to-day owner: Alice Monroe, Data Platform Director (integration lead)

3) Immediate asks you requested
- SOC 2 report or summary document (scope and date)
- Pen-test summary and remediation status
- Audit logs & retention policy (how long logs persisted, export options)
- Network diagram and data flow for our private deployment model

4) Proposed mutual action plan (MAP)
- 2026-06-04: Redwood to share SOC2 summary, pen-test summary, network diagram (attached)
- 2026-06-07: 30-min technical sync: Tom + Markus + Olga to validate evidence and run quick threat/Q&A
- 2026-06-14: Procurement review complete; draft SOW/PO or follow-up on redlines
- Decision target: w/c 2026-06-21

Attachments I’ll send in a follow-up email: SOC2 summary, pen-test brief, and a simple network diagram. Also linking a short one-page integration checklist in HubSpot for your team.

If any of the stakeholder roles above are incorrect or I missed someone, please flag and I’ll update the MAP.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

[attachment stub: network-architecture-diagram.png (PNG, 82 KB)]

From: Ben Chu <ben.chu@skywardhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@skywardhealth.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@skywardhealth.com>, procurement@skywardhealth.com
Date: Wed, Jun 2, 2026 at 09:04 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + stakeholder map / evidence requests — Skyward Health

Neha — thanks for the clear recap. Couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Marta is indeed the economic buyer; she will need a short TCO model and contract term options (12/24/36 months).
- Procurement contact is procurement@skywardhealth.com (they’ll own SLA + indemnity redlines).
- Tom Everett will take point for security evidence; he’s asked for a pen-test summary (not necessarily full report) and confirmation of logging retention policies for 13 months minimum.

A few notes on timeline and constraints:
- Procurement intends to complete initial redline pass by 2026-06-11.
- Any SOC 2 evidence must indicate the assessment date (we can accept an internal SOC2 summary if the official report is under NDA).

Action items for Redwood: please send SOC2 summary + pen-test brief + explicit statement of log retention and sprawl controls. Also include an itemized list of APIs/endpoints that will receive PHI and whether they will be fronted by our VPC connector.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate Marta’s availability for a commercial call once we have the TCO.

—Ben
Ben Chu
Head of Data Platforms | Skyward Health
ben.chu@skywardhealth.com

Date: Thu, Jun 3, 2026 at 08:32 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + stakeholder map / evidence requests — Skyward Health

Ben / Alice — attaching the items we discussed. Highlights below to make it easy for Marta / Tom / procurement to triage.

Attachments (also uploaded to the shared Drive link):
- Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf — scope: Security + Availability, last assessed 2026-02, auditor: NorthStar LLP (summary only; full report available under NDA)
- pen-test-brief.txt (summary) — Engaged third party in Q1 2026; two medium findings remediated (CVE mapping included)
- network-architecture-diagram.png — shows VPC connector and optional on-prem proxy pattern
- Skyward_Security_Questionnaire_2026.xlsx — we answered your questionnaire inline (sheet tabs by control area)

Quick answers to your checklist requests:
- Log retention: Audit logs retained 13 months by default; exports to customer-owned S3 available on request.
- PHI handling: Customer-data-in-scope endpoints are explicitly listed in the questionnaire (sheet: PHI_endpoints). All PHI is encrypted at rest and in transit.
- Pen test: summary attached; full exec report available under NDA within 48–72 hours.

Proposed next steps (confirming the MAP dates I suggested):
- 2026-06-07 11:00 AM PT — security sync: Tom + Markus + Olga (30 min). Please confirm if that works; if Tom prefers a different time we’ll accommodate.
- 2026-06-11 — procurement redline pass target (we can accept DocuSign + track changes).
- We’ll prepare a short TCO output for Marta — can you confirm whether she prefers monthly OPEX or annualized comparisons?

If helpful I can include a short one-pager that maps each question in your questionnaire to the specific section in the SOC2 summary / pen-test brief to speed Tom’s review.

Thanks — attaching now.

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (PDF, 250 KB)
- pen-test-brief.txt (TXT, 12 KB)

- network-architecture-diagram.png (PNG, 82 KB)

Subject: Re: Recap + stakeholder map / evidence requests — Skyward Health

Neha — received the packet, thank you. A few quick items from procurement/security: 

- Procurement (cc’d) will send a short list of standard redlines; please confirm you can accept our liability cap language or propose a tracked change.
- Tom — I’ve added you to the Drive folder (link below). Can we do the 06/07 11:00 AM PT slot?
- Marta — we’ll need the TCO by 06/09 to give you time before your budget review the week of 06/14. Marta, do you prefer a 15-min commercial summary or a short written note?

Tom / procurement: please review the SOC2 summary and pen-test brief in the Drive. I highlighted the PHI endpoint appendix in the questionnaire; Tom, if you can validate encryption + retention details during the sync that would be perfect.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Skyward/Security/Response-2026

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the sync.

Best,
Alice Monroe
Director, Data Platform | Skyward Health
